mentions.name: ArtCraft
mentions.description: ArtCraft and the Craft Apps are an open-source ecosystem spanning software, SaaS, infrastructure, model weights, platforms, and protocols. The project bridges local and cloud compute, operates as an app factory for high-throughput development, provides reverse-engineering tools for non-technical people, publishes high-quality libraries others can remix, and makes everything agentic and AI/CLI-first.
mentions.audience: Non-technical people (for reverse-engineering tools), plus a hacker-first open-source community
mentions.source_excerpt:
ArtCraft and the Craft Apps.
https://getartcraft.com

We're going to open source everything. Software, SaaS, infrastructure, weights, platforms, protocols.

We're going to bridge local and cloud compute in a seamless way.

We're building an app factory for high throughout development. Reverse engineering tools for non-technical people. We're going to make high quality libraries that others can remix.

We're going to make all of this agentic and AI/CLI first class.
mentions.author: possibilistic
